Parent criticizes Bengaluru international school over alleged harsh environment

A parent has publicly criticized an international school in Bengaluru, describing the environment as 'harsh and toxic'. The parent, identified as a US citizen, shared their experience and warned other parents considering the school, particularly those moving back to India. The school reportedly charges an annual fee of ₹5 lakh.
